These edge states behave as I’d expect. Keeping invalid input in place for correction is especially helpful, and an unreachable page should still be saveable—automatic details are useful, but they shouldn’t be a requirement.

For long text, I’d let titles wrap and remain fully visible. Descriptions can be shortened after a few lines to keep the list readable, with a “Show more” control for the full text.

The empty collection, empty views, no-results message, invalid-address handling, and save-anyway fallback all feel right.
